Plain-English Viva Interpretation: On weekday evenings when domestic lighting is switched on, occupants are actively at home. Cooking dinner, operating dishwashers, and running entertainment appliances elevate energy draw. The lift of over 2.0x demonstrates that high usage is more than twice as likely under this condition than by random chance.

Active lighting during morning hours (06:00-11:59) indicates household waking routine. Electric water heaters, kettles, toasters, and morning grooming appliances create sharp demand spikes well above the 100 Wh baseline.

On weekends during afternoon hours, residential occupancy remains elevated compared to empty weekday afternoons. Laundry chores (washing machines, tumble dryers, electric irons) frequently cluster during weekend daytime, driving sustained high energy demand.
